overloads.semanticRole: Inserts one or more columns into the table intersecting a range, element, or 4D Write Pro document.

discriminatedBy.note: targetObj resolved to the first intersecting table; command does nothing (returns Null, no error) if no table/text range intersects

overloads.semanticRole: Inserts one or more columns into a specific table at a given column index, addressed by table reference.

discriminatedBy.note: 2-3 arg form addressing a table by reference plus explicit column index

constraints: If colNumber is higher than the number of columns in tableRef, the columns are appended rather than inserted.
Returns a column range representing the inserted column(s), or Null if nothing was inserted.
